title: Constables (1872-1933)
key_finding: The Town of Babylon states that its Police Department started in 1947 and was dissolved and merged into the Suffolk County Police Department effective January 1, 1960.

title: Town Directory
key_finding: The Town directory lists Public Safety, Fire Marshal's Office, and other departments, but does not list a Town Police Department.

title: Code Enforcement
key_finding: Babylon's Code Enforcement division works closely with local police and government agencies and can issue summonses, indicating a support/enforcement role rather than general policing.

title: Park Rangers
key_finding: Park Rangers are NYS peace officers responsible for protecting town parks and maintaining order within Town parks and recreational facilities.

title: Bay Constables
key_finding: Bay Constables patrol the Great South Bay and Town beaches and facilities as NYS peace officers.

title: What is a Hamlet?
key_finding: The Town says it is comprised of ten hamlets and three incorporated villages.

title: Town History
key_finding: The Town history page identifies the three incorporated villages inside Babylon town as Amityville, Babylon, and Lindenhurst.

title: Public Safety
key_finding: Suffolk County states that its Police Department provides all police services for the five western towns, including Babylon, and separately provides various services for incorporated villages that maintain their own police departments.

title: First Precinct
key_finding: The First Precinct states that it proudly covers the Town of Babylon.

title: Police Department
key_finding: Amityville maintains an official village Police Department with its own phone number, chief, and emergency guidance.

title: Village of Babylon Departments
key_finding: Babylon Village directs emergency matters to 911 and quality-of-life complaints to Code Enforcement, while presenting no village police department.

title: Contact the Village of Babylon
key_finding: Babylon Village lists Police as 911 in its emergency numbers and lists village offices such as Code Enforcement separately.

title: Village of Lindenhurst Contact Information
key_finding: Lindenhurst lists Police Emergency as 911 and does not present a village police department in its official contact information.

title: Village Square Public Safety Office Opens
key_finding: Lindenhurst states that its Village Public Safety Officers work with the Suffolk County Police Department to provide an additional layer of safety.
